3. The lands of the claimants as shown in the above chart were acquired for submergence of the Hatnur project by Notification dated 27.09.1990 issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

The final award was passed on 24.02.1993.
4.

The learned A.G.P. for the appellants pointed out the grounds  fa1123.02-  -4- of objections in the appeals and submitted that the compensation awarded to the claimants is exorbitant and not as per the market value of the acquired lands and the valuation of orchids of pomegranate etc. were also awarded at higher rate.

The findings State Of Maha vs Vasant Lotu Patil on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143076050/
3 and the reasons of the learned Reference Court are not correct.

sentences.text: The learned Reference court has not appreciated the evidence properly and has awarded exorbitant amount of compensation to the claimants.
The relevant sale exemplars were also not properly appreciated while determining the compensation.

The compensation for irrigated land at Rs.3,42,915/- per Hectare is exorbitant as per the market rate prevailing at the time of acquisition of the lands in question, particularly at the time of publication of notification under Section 4 of the L.A. Act on 18.10.1990.
The evidence of Ravindra Dhanaji Choudhari, the valuer was shaken in the cross examination.
However, it has been erroneously relied upon by the learned Reference Court.

While appreciating the sale exemplar Exh.25, the learned Reference court has considered the distance between acquired land and the land in the sale exemplar and for that purpose the property Exh.22 and 23 is not considered.
The answering respondents had examined the purchaser, Narayan Krisna Mahajan to prove the sale exemplar, in which distance was clarified to be half a kilometer from the acquired land.
It is submitted that the evidence adduced by the claimants is not reliable.

The reasons and findings of  fa1123.02-  -5- the learned Reference Court are not legal and correct and therefore,
interference is warranted in the impugned judgment and award.
It is lastly prayed to allow the appeals by setting aside the impugned judgment and award and by reducing the compensation awarded by the learned Reference Court.

5. The learned advocate for the respondents-claimants strongly State Of Maha vs Vasant Lotu Patil on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143076050/
4 opposed the appeals and submitted that the compensation awarded by the learned Reference court is reasonable and in accordance with the market value of the acquired land, as the lands are irrigated lands.

sentences.text: The compensation awarded for 500 pomegranate trees, 200 guava trees, 60 custard apple trees is also just and proper to establish that Ravindra Choudhari, the valuer was examined.
His evidence was not shaken in the cross examination.

The sale exemplar at Exh.25 is properly appreciated and the learned Reference Court has given proper reasons and awarded the compensation after considering the market value of the land with evidence of comparable sale exemplar Exh.25.
It is submitted to dismiss the appeals.
6. Perused the record and proceedings, particularly, oral and documentary evidence, the valuer's report alongwith the reasons and findings recorded with the impugned judgment and award.
The learned Reference Court has thoroughly discussed the sale exemplar  fa1123.02-  -6- Exh.25 holding that the distance between the acquired land and the land in sale exemplar is only one furlong.
Therefore, after comparing the said sale exemplars Exh.22 and 23, the learned Reference court came to the right conclusion that it is comparable sale exemplar.

The learned Reference Court also granted escalation of 10% amount of compensation awarded for the acquired land on the basis of the cogent and acceptable evidence, which is just and proper as per the market price.

7. On re-appreciation of evidence of Ravindra Chaudhari, this State Of Maha vs Vasant Lotu Patil on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143076050/
5 court finds that the valuer's report has been rightly appreciated by the learned Reference Court and awarded reasonable amount of compensation for the acquired lands.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The sale exemplar Exh.25 is in respect of non-irrigated land.
Thus, the learned Reference Court has rightly awarded the double amount of the sale exemplar, as the lands of the claimants are irrigated lands having orchids etc.
There is absolutely no ground to interfere in the impugned judgment and award.
The appeals therefore, deserves to be dismissed.
Hence, the following order.
ORDER The first appeals are dismissed.
No order as to costs.

(SANJAY A. DESHMUKH, J.) rlj/
